tier1.headline: Your Data Collected Elsewhere
tier1.quote: If you come to GOV.UK from another website, we may receive personal information from the other website.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Internally
tier2.quote: The data we collect may be shared with other government departments, agencies and organisations.

tier2.headline: Your Data Retained Indefinitely
tier2.quote: We will only retain your personal data for as long as it is needed for the purposes set out in this document or for as long as the law requires us to.

tier2.headline: Your Data Transferred Internationally
tier2.quote: Data collected by Google Analytics and SpeedCurve RUM may be transferred outside the EEA for processing.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Legally
tier2.quote: We will share your data if we are required to do so by law - for example, by court order, or to prevent fraud or other crime.
